# MCP Install Methods by Client (from official docs / context7.com)
# Used by DD.CMD MCP menu and sync scripts. Do not edit manually unless updating from upstream.

# ---- Context7 (and similar HTTP MCP) ----

# Claude Code (claude CLI)
# Local stdio:
#   claude mcp add --scope user context7 -- npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp --api-key YOUR_API_KEY
# Remote HTTP:
#   claude mcp add --scope user --header "CONTEXT7_API_KEY: YOUR_API_KEY" --transport http context7 https://mcp.context7.com/mcp
# Scope: user (~/.claude.json) | project (.mcp.json) | local (default, project path in ~/.claude.json)

# Codex CLI (OpenAI - codex)
# List: codex mcp list
# Add stdio: codex mcp add context7 -- npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp --api-key YOUR_API_KEY
# Add HTTP:  codex mcp add context7 --url https://mcp.context7.com/mcp (then set http_headers via config or env)
# Config: ~/.codex/config.toml  [mcp_servers.context7] url = "..." http_headers = { "CONTEXT7_API_KEY" = "..." }
# Or: codex mcp add context7 --url https://mcp.context7.com/mcp (headers may need config.toml edit)

# Gemini CLI (gemini)
# Add stdio: gemini mcp add context7 npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp --api-key YOUR_API_KEY
# Add HTTP:  gemini mcp add --transport http context7 https://mcp.context7.com/mcp -H "CONTEXT7_API_KEY: YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Accept: application/json, text/event-stream"
# Config: ~/.gemini/settings.json or .gemini/settings.json  mcpServers.context7.httpUrl + headers

# Factory Droid (droid CLI)
# Remote: droid mcp add context7 https://mcp.context7.com/mcp --type http --header "CONTEXT7_API_KEY: YOUR_API_KEY"
# Local:  droid mcp add context7 "npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp" --env CONTEXT7_API_KEY=YOUR_API_KEY

# Cursor (no CLI for MCP)
# Edit ~/.cursor/mcp.json or .cursor/mcp.json (project). Remote: "context7": { "url": "https://mcp.context7.com/mcp", "headers": { "CONTEXT7_API_KEY": "YOUR_API_KEY" } }
# Local: "context7": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@upstash/context7-mcp", "--api-key", "YOUR_API_KEY"] }

# GitHub Copilot Coding Agent (no CLI)
# Repository -> Settings -> Copilot -> Coding agent -> MCP configuration (JSON in UI). type: "http" or "local", url/command, headers, tools.

# Amp (amp CLI)
# amp mcp add context7 https://mcp.context7.com/mcp
# amp mcp add context7 --header "CONTEXT7_API_KEY=YOUR_API_KEY" https://mcp.context7.com/mcp

# Qwen Code (qwen CLI)
# Remote: qwen mcp add --transport http context7 https://mcp.context7.com/mcp --header "CONTEXT7_API_KEY: YOUR_API_KEY" --header "Accept: application/json, text/event-stream"
# Local:  qwen mcp add context7 npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp --api-key YOUR_API_KEY

# One-shot setup (Context7 official): npx ctx7 setup   (--cursor, --claude, --opencode to target agent)
